description: Source code for ArticlesController in an ASP.NET Core Web API project, defining endpoints for article retrieval, creation, editing, and deletion.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller handling HTTP requests related to articles, including retrieving lists, getting details, creating, editing, and deleting articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of articles, with optional filtering by tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the user's personalized article feed.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific article by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article by its slug, requiring authorization.
